user_query: I'm planning a movie night with my friends and we want to start the evening with some jokes. Can you suggest some movie-themed Chuck Norris jokes? Also, provide us with the game schedule and team standings of our favorite NBA team to plan future movie nights around their games.

TaskList.description: Retrieve a collection of movie-themed Chuck Norris jokes for the movie night.
Fetch the game schedule of the user's favorite NBA team.
Retrieve the current team standings of the user's favorite NBA team.
